headline: The new public reports expose every customer’s personal details without requiring a staff login.
what_changed: The home page now shows a customer-list download link and loads chart add-on code.
Anyone who knows the report web addresses can request monthly order totals.
Anyone can download a customer list containing names, email addresses, phone numbers, birthdays, and lifetime spending.

risks.title: Customer list is public
risks.explanation: The new customer-list download has no staff-login check. Any visitor can obtain every customer’s name, email, phone number, birthday, and spending total. This is a direct privacy breach and should not ship until access is limited to approved staff.

risks.title: Spreadsheet values are unsafe
risks.explanation: Customer-provided text is placed straight into the download without safe spreadsheet formatting. If a customer name begins with a spreadsheet command, opening the file could run that command for the accountant. Safely format each value before creating the download.

risks.title: Sales totals are public
risks.explanation: The monthly report also has no staff-login check. Anyone can view the company’s order totals by month, which exposes confidential business performance. Apply the same staff-only access rule.

good_news: The new reporting code is small and separate from the existing customer pages.
